what_it_says: 25 years as conductor and chorus master of the Moscow Imperial opera; cellist by training; lists operas he staged/revived
remark: Only operas named (Игорь, Ночь подъ Рождество, Русалка etc.); no ballet

what_it_says: 25 years of conducting: Petersburg conservatory, Kiev opera, from 1882-83 chief kapellmeister of the Moscow Imperial Russian opera and head of the orchestra's affairs; coronation cantata 1896
remark: Opera only throughout («специфическій оперный дирижерскій талантъ»); no ballet word

ballet_quote_verbatim: Въ 1896 году (годъ коронаціи) его командируютъ въ Большой театръ ставить балетъ Конюса «Даная», а въ 1906 г. его назначаютъ дирижеромъ Московскаго балета. Юбиляръ является однимъ изъ музыкально образованнѣйшихъ балетныхъ капельмейстеровъ. [...] имъ написанъ на сюжетъ романа Флобера 4 актный балетъ «Саламбо».
what_it_says: Violinist in the Moscow theatre orchestra, Maly Theatre conductor, then conductor of the Moscow ballet from 1906; conducted Lebedinoe ozero, Spyashchaya krasavitsa, Raimonda; composed the ballet Salambo
remark: Also names predecessor ballet conductor А. И. Лузинъ. Text prints «Даная» (Konyus's ballet is usually Даита) - quoted as printed

what_it_says: 40 years of musical activity: violin virtuoso, conservatory professor, conductor of symphonic assemblies; over 30 years soloist of the orchestra of the Imperial Russian opera
remark: Text says only «солистомъ оркестра Императорской русской оперы» - the orchestra is named as the opera's, ballet is not mentioned anywhere (his ballet violin solos are outside knowledge, not in the text)

ballet_quote_verbatim: съ октября 1889 года числится почетнымъ членомъ конференціи Московскаго театральнаго училища
what_it_says: 50 years of literary activity: list of his plays, translations, theatre criticism and articles; member of the Literary-Theatrical Committee; honorary member of the conference of the Moscow Theatre School since 1889
remark: BORDERLINE: the only link is the honorary seat on the Moscow Theatre School's conference (school governance body); no ballet, dance or ballet work is named. If an honorary seat does not count as administering the school, this is none

ballet_quote_verbatim: Въ нихъ принимали участіе между прочимъ пѣвица г-жа Пускова, обладавшая феноменальнымъ контральто, танцовщица Московскаго театра г-жа Гиллертъ и извѣстный танцовщикъ Бекеффи.
what_it_says: Drama actress (40 years on stage, 35 on the Imperial stage), drama teacher; in April 1876 she played in the Russian performances her husband S. V. Taneev organised at the Paris Ventadour theatre, in which the Moscow dancer Gillert and the dancer Bekefi also took part
remark: She herself is drama only; the ballet content is the two named dancers in the 1876 Paris performances (Сухонинъ's «Русская свадьба»). Also «пьесы ... фееріи» at the Общедоступный театръ - not ballet

what_it_says: 40 years on stage: drama actor's own account of provincial engagements (Kursk, Zhitomir, Odessa, Kharkov, Vilno), Alexandrinsky debut, Maly Theatre, Korsh, Yavorskaya; over 300 roles
remark: Drama only; no ballet content

what_it_says: 20 years of opera: contralto of the Moscow Bolshoi, farewell benefit 18 November; training (Everardi, Viardot), Tiflis, 40 operas in repertoire
remark: Opera roles only (Ратмиръ, Полина, Ваня, Рогнѣда); no ballet

what_it_says: 25 years as composer: Tiflis music school director, Moscow conservatory professor and now director, conductor of Mamontov's private opera and Zimin's theatre; three operas and sacred music
remark: No ballet content

ballet_quote_verbatim: если считать мою службу въ балетѣ съ 16 лѣтъ, я нахожусь при театрѣ уже 46 лѣтъ. [...] Въ балетѣ меня стали занимать тоже очень рано. Танцовальному искусству въ школѣ обучалась я сначала у Гариновскаго, потомъ у А. Н. Богданова и затѣмъ у Гюге. [...] я 10 лѣтъ исполняла съ Канцеревой, впослѣдствіи извѣстной танцовщицей, въ школьномъ спектаклѣ pas de deux галопъ [...] я была выпущена корифейкой на 300 руб. въ балетъ.
what_it_says: Drama actress's autobiography: entered the Petersburg theatre school at 6, trained in dance under Garinovsky, A. N. Bogdanov and Huguet, graduated as a coryphee into the ballet at 16, hated it and left for provincial drama in 1869; later Maly and Petersburg drama troupes
remark: Drama artist who began in the ballet troupe. Also: danced a quadrille in the drama «Вѣчный жидъ»; father played first violin in the Imperial theatres' orchestra; mentions Director Count Борхъ

ballet_quote_verbatim: Въ настоящее время юбиляръ работаетъ надъ партитурою балета, сюита изъ которой исполнялась 28 ноября 1909 года въ юбилейномъ его концертѣ.
what_it_says: 35 years of musical activity and 25 as chorus master of the Russian opera; composer of operas Knyaz Serebryany, Pan sotnik, Marfinka; now working on the score of a ballet, a suite from which was played at his jubilee concert 28 Nov 1909
remark: Ballet is unnamed in the text. «вальсъ Шопена» is a piano piece, not dance

what_it_says: 25 years of theatre service: provincial character actor and prompter, Moscow private theatres, prompter of the Petersburg Imperial drama troupe from 1884, stage director from 1891
remark: Drama only; no ballet content

what_it_says: 50 years of musical activity: fortification professor and composer of nine operas, one-act operas, and an act of the ballet-opera Mlada (1872); music critic
remark: Only ballet content is the named ballet-opera «Млада» in his list of works. His criticism is described as musical, not ballet. Text prints Moniuszko study year as 1898 (evident misprint)

what_it_says: 50 years of activity: Stuttgart-born music teacher and composer, founder of the Caucasian music society, opera Taras Bulba (Mariinsky 1880-81), inspector/director of music at several institutes and of the Stolichnaya music school
remark: No ballet content

what_it_says: Opera prima donna of the 1860s-70s; born Vienna 1841, sang in the Petersburg Italian opera 1867-69 (Faust, Cherubino, Zerlina); left the stage 1887
remark: Opera only; no ballet content

what_it_says: 45 years of musical activity: from assistant kapellmeister of the Russian opera (after replacing an absent pianist in Ruslan in 1862) to chief kapellmeister; operas Nizhegorodtsy, Harold, Dubrovsky, Francesca da Rimini; RMO symphonic conductor
remark: Opera and symphonic only; no ballet content. «управляющаго Императорскими театрами» is only the official who noticed him

ballet_quote_verbatim: Анна Матвѣевна Павлова 2-я (зачислена въ балетъ съ 1 іюля 1899 года). [...] А. М. Павлова выступила въ балетѣ «Баядерка», въ роли Никіи. [...] Отличительныя свойства талантливой балерины: замѣчательная подвижность и удивительная мимика.
what_it_says: Ballerina's 10-year jubilee on the Mariinsky stage, 18 Nov 1909, dancing Nikia in Bayaderka; lists her roles in 20 ballets and about 300 appearances in opera
remark: Heading as printed on the page is «Анна Матвѣевна Павлова» with «2-я» in the text. List of 20 ballets with roles (Арлекинада ... Эсмеральда)

ballet_quote_verbatim: Сначала я завѣдывалъ классами драматическаго искусства въ школѣ Филармоническаго общества, потомъ въ театральной школѣ Императорскихъ театровъ.
what_it_says: Maly Theatre actor's autobiography: amateur stage, Helsingfors, Novocherkassk, Tiflis, Alexandrinsky debuts 1875, Maly debut 1878, crown roles; about 20 years of theatre pedagogy, heading the drama classes of the Philharmonic school and then of the Imperial theatre school
remark: BORDERLINE: only link is that he headed the DRAMA classes in the Imperial theatre school (a post within the school, not ballet). No ballet, dancer or ballet work named. Look-alike: «танцовальный вечеръ въ гельсингфорскомъ военномъ собраніи» is a social dance evening (officers dancing with actresses), not ballet. If heading the drama classes does not count as administering the school, this is none

what_it_says: 50 years of artistic career: opera diva born 1839, child concerts in America, New York debut 1859 in Lucia, London, Paris, Petersburg 1869 (Sonnambula), three seasons there; now married to Baron Cederström
remark: Opera only; «площади Большого театра» is the Petersburg Bolshoi as venue of the Italian opera; no ballet content

ballet_quote_verbatim: О. О. Преображенская, справлявшая на дняхъ свое двадцатилѣтнее служеніе балету, принадлежитъ къ числу выдающихся танцовщицъ. [...] въ балетѣ «Талисманъ», въ роли Нориты [...] Талантливая балерина участвовала въ нижепоименованныхъ 33-хъ балетахъ
what_it_says: Ballerina's 20 years in the ballet; jubilee performance 29 November in Talisman as Norita; over 600 appearances in opera and ballet; list of 33 ballets with her roles
remark: Subheading: «По поводу двадцатилѣтія ея пребыванія въ балетѣ»

what_it_says: 40 years on stage, 28 at the Moscow Maly: daughter of the singer O. L. Lazarev, debut 1869 at the Artistic Circle, Lentovsky's theatre, Maly from 1879-81; best roles in Ostrovsky, Tolstoy, Gogol etc.
remark: Drama only; family ties stated are to a singer (father) and drama actor M. P. Sadovsky (husband); no ballet content

what_it_says: 80th birthday of the Italian tragedian: Garibaldi movement, Othello, Russian visits 1867 (with Ristori), Odessa 1880, Petersburg/Moscow 1882 (Mariinsky stage) and 1901 (Alexandrinsky); left the stage October 1903
remark: Drama only; Mariinsky is named only as the venue of his dramatic performances; no ballet content

what_it_says: 40 years at the Moscow Maly: son of Prov Sadovsky, debut 1867 at the Artistic Circle and 1869 at the Maly, Ostrovsky comic roles, translator (Beaumarchais, Sophocles, Racine), playwright and story writer; jubilee in Dokhodnoe mesto
remark: Drama only; wife O. O. Lazareva is a drama actress; «Донъ-Жуанъ»/«Севильскій цирульникъ» are the Moliere/Beaumarchais plays; no ballet content

what_it_says: 40 years of critical and compositional activity: conservatory professor of theory and composition, operas Kuznets Vakula, Cordelia, Domik v Kolomne, cantatas, assistant director of the Imperial Court Chapel from 1906, music critic
remark: Critic of music («музыкальную хронику»), not ballet; no ballet work in the list of compositions

what_it_says: 50 years of literary and stage activity: feuilletonist and theatre reviewer, owner of Novoe Vremya and of his own theatre; his plays Tatyana Repina, Medea, Tsar Dmitry Samozvanets, Vopros and two one-act jokes
remark: Theatre reviews are of drama (Savina, Strepetova, Zankovetskaya); no ballet content

what_it_says: 10 years on the Imperial stage: amateur troupe as a youth, Imperial Theatre School drama courses (class of Vl. Davydov), into the Imperial drama troupe 1898, tours with Savina and Komissarzhevskaya, 357 roles, playwright
remark: Look-alikes: he entered the Theatre School's DRAMA courses, not the ballet department; his play «На перепутьи» (Alexandrinsky, 4 Nov 1908) shares its title with a ballet listed in the Pavlova entry but is a drama. No ballet content
